blocks.source: From the hints given in the previous chapter you may have already guessed the first theorem of this chapter. We know that if $f$ is integrable, then $F(x)=\int_a^x f$ is continuous; it is only fitting that we ask what happens when the original function $f$ is continuous. blocks.source: The problem of computing this integral is discussed later, but it provides a good opportunity to warn against a serious error. The conclusion of Corollary 1 is often confused with the definition of integrals—many students think that $\int_a^b f$ is defined as: “$g(b)-g(a)$, where $g$ is a function whose derivative is $f$.” This “definition” is not only wrong—it is useless. One reason is that a function $f$ may be integrable without being the derivative of another function. For example, if $f(x)=0$ for $x\ne1$ and $f(1)=1$, then $f$ is integrable, but $f$ cannot be a derivative (why not?). There is also another reason that is much more important: If $f$ is continuous,
blocks.translation: 这个积分的计算问题将在后面讨论，不过它提供了一个好机会，让我们提醒你警惕一种严重错误。推论 1 的结论常被误认为是积分的定义——许多学生以为，$\int_a^b f$ 被定义为：“$g(b)-g(a)$，其中 $g$ 是一个导数为 $f$ 的函数。”这种“定义”不仅错误，而且毫无用处。一个原因是，函数 $f$ 可能可积，却不是另一个函数的导数。例如，若在 $x\ne1$ 时有 $f(x)=0$，且 $f(1)=1$，那么 $f$ 可积，但 $f$ 不可能是导数（为什么？）。还有另一个重要得多的原因：如果 $f$ 连续，

These remarks are not meant to suggest that you should regard exercising ingenuity to compute areas as beneath you, but are meant to indicate that a better approach to the definition of area is available, although its proper place is somewhere in advanced calculus. The desire to define area was the motivation, both in this book and historically, for the definition of the integral, but the integral does not really provide the best method of *defining* areas, although it is frequently the proper tool for *computing* them.

blocks.source: (a) If $f(x)=1/\sqrt x$ for $0\le x\le1$ and $f(x)=1/x^2$ for $x\ge1$, find $\int_0^\infty f(x)dx$ (after deciding what this should mean).
blocks.translation: (a) 如果当 $0\le x\le1$ 时有 $f(x)=1/\sqrt x$，当 $x\ge1$ 时有 $f(x)=1/x^2$，求 $\int_0^\infty f(x)dx$（先决定它应当是什么意思）。

blocks.source: (b) Show that $\int_0^\infty x^r dx$ never makes sense. (Distinguish the cases $-1<r<0$ and $r<-1$. In one case things go wrong at $0$, in the other case at $\infty$; for $r=-1$ things go wrong at both places.)
blocks.translation: (b) 证明 $\int_0^\infty x^r dx$ 始终没有意义。（区分 $-1<r<0$ 和 $r<-1$ 两种情形。一种情形在 $0$ 处出问题，另一种在 $\infty$ 处出问题；当 $r=-1$ 时，两处都出问题。）
